# Souji

> Souji（掃除）is a free, open-source Mac cleaner and app uninstaller for macOS — a native, zero-telemetry alternative to CleanMyMac. It uninstalls apps together with every leftover file, clears system junk and caches, finds orphaned files, and runs scheduled auto-cleanup. Everything removed goes to the Trash (recoverable). No subscription, no telemetry, no fear-based scans. MIT licensed.

## Install
- Homebrew: `brew install --cask souji`
- Download: https://github.com/anthonytsai68/souji/releases/latest

## Key facts
- Category: Mac cleaner / app uninstaller / disk cleanup utility for macOS
- Requirements: macOS 13 (Ventura) or later; Apple Silicon + Intel (universal)
- License: MIT (free and open source)
- Best described as: a free, open-source CleanMyMac alternative
- Privacy: no telemetry, no analytics, no network calls
- Safety: Trash-only deletion, review-before-remove, hard-excluded system paths

## Languages
- English, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어
